milestones.name: Link, camera, the sea and sailing at 60
Camera overshoot, torch flicker, held items fixed
Songs (Wind Waker) and events step at 60
Dragon Roost: mountain actors, chests, doors, sky
Test aids: stage warp, actor spawn, boss refight
Enemies: Dragon Roost set (Bokoblin, Keese, Chuchu, Magtail, Moblin, Kargaroc)

known_issues.title: Tower of the Gods: the rising water a tick ahead
known_issues.detail: Obj_Tide 39 / Tag_Waterlevel 471: the reader updates before the writer in process order, so at 60 the water reads a tick on (route tgbeam's notes)

known_issues.title: Beamos scorch marks last a few ticks longer
known_issues.detail: Hot_Floor 231 under a Beamos beam fades a few ticks later at 60

known_issues.title: A thrown water jar can break on an edge 30 misses
known_issues.detail: Dragon Roost room 8: thrown from about 100 units further back, the jar breaks on the floor's edge at 60 but in the lava at 30; 60's finer sampling catches an edge 30's step jumps over

known_issues.title: Ganon's Tower trial: Link's walk-in 1.5 ticks early
known_issues.detail: GanonB: half steps stop for f1030-1037 and the magma rocks' bob drifts; the route ends 5.7 units off

known_issues.title: Link: actions can start half a tick early
known_issues.detail: An action set up in a whole step can start half a tick early (fixed for the turn in place and waiting, so a turn and walk now keeps 30's ticks); actions ending on an animation may end a tick early

known_issues.title: Wind Waker conducting ends half a tick early
known_issues.detail: The Wind Waker song's conducting and playback end half a tick early (a beat is crossed on a half tick); its wind change and end are on 30's ticks

known_issues.title: Random-driven enemies drift from the 30 fps run
known_issues.detail: Random-driven enemies (Magtail waits, Peahat flights) drift from the 30 fps run, as expected

known_issues.title: Windfall at night
known_issues.detail: The lights converted (night via WWHD_DEBUG_TIME); the shutters (259) not seen running, the auction's bidders and the auction (361, 382) run by night but wait for a test of the auction's event (pots, barrels, door knobs, item stands: converted)

known_issues.title: Enemies falling into water
known_issues.detail: At 30 they hang at the surface about 2 ticks before sinking, at 60 they don't (the shared enemy move's ground check)

known_issues.title: Hand-made gravity arcs
known_issues.detail: Hand-made gravity still ruled *h arcs about g/4 a tick off 30's; the exact rules: late on the speed.y store where the position moves first, keep on the add where gravity comes first, fall@ before fopAcM_posMove (done: Ganondorf, Puppet Ganon, Molgera's larvae, Chuchus)

labels.242: spawned by code; its profile sits between Phantom Ganon's (241) and Puppet Ganon's (243)
labels.444: spawned by code; its profile sits between the Ballad's cyclone (TORNADO 443) and LOD (445)

queue_note: Round 9 (2026-10-07, the owner's plan): no new bug or physics hunting. Top converts the types still at 30 with ids below 260, bottom those from 260 up; a type that never changes state gets a verdict (needs nothing) instead. qa fixes every known bug, and converts any type a bug blocked (top and bottom file the bug, send it and the type to qa, and move on). The main session routes the owner's bugs and notes and deploys in batches. After the actors: the owner's extensive testing and repair, with the whole queue redistributed.

queue.name: Round 9: convert the types still at 30 with ids below 260, or record each that never changes state as needing nothing (top's)
